svg.title: Recorded Gemma 3 throughput and target KV allocation on a MacBook Air M4
svg.desc: September 29, 2026: ordinary F32 10.51, ordinary F16 11.00, H1 F32 13.62, H1 F16 15.78 tokens per completion second. Durable target KV at 16K capacity is 2.625 GiB with F32 and 1.3125 GiB with F16. One cooled naturally stopping two-turn conversation per mode; response lengths and histories differ. No competitor data is represented. Counts and provenance appear in docs/PERFORMANCE.md.
